title: showcase tour
description: A showcase tour (format 1): steps of beats, each with narration and the actions performed while it is spoken. See `showcase docs tour-format`.

id.description: The tour's id: file name, storyboard, voice manifest and output folder.

takeaway.description: What the viewer should believe afterwards, in one line.

targetSec.description: The film's target length. The presets are 60, 90, 120, 180 and 300.

narration.description: Override the narration window, in seconds of readingMs.

firstToCut.description: The beat to drop first if the film runs long. Required from 2:00.

approved.description: Approval dates, recorded by the skill.

anchor.description: Find an element. Preference: role and name, label, test id, text, CSS.

role.description: An ARIA role, e.g. button, link, textbox.

text.description: Visible text; with css, a filter.

exact.description: Match name, label and text exactly (default: contains, case-insensitive).

nth.description: Which match: 0 the first, -1 the last. Default 0.

frame.description: A same-origin iframe (CSS in the top document).

after.description: Start this sentence once that action of the beat is done.

kicker.description: A small line in capitals under the title (showcase 1.1).

id.description: Unique within its beat. A sentence's `after` names it.

label.description: What the action does, in words: the storyboard and the report show it.

effect.description: A write changes the app's state and needs `done` (C6).

done.description: Holds once the action has taken effect. Already holding means the action is skipped.

timeoutMs.description: How long the target or `done` may take. Default 10 s for a target.

navigates.description: The action causes a full page load. It must be the last action of its beat, and runs after the beat's narration.

input.description: Override how input is delivered (injected runs default to trusted).

url.description: A path (`/search?q=x`) or an absolute URL.
